北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，气温低，多穿保暖，别忘了享受阳光！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's chilly, bundle up and enjoy the sunshine!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪好天气，气温舒适，记得添衣，保持好心情哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi, lovely weather! A comfy 13℃, dress accordingly and stay cheerful!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，气温 11℃，早晚温差大，注意添减衣物哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is clear, 11℃. Mind the temperature changes, dress wisely!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云 20℃，体感舒适，记得多喝水，保持活力！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm at 20℃, stay hydrated and vibrant!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗 19℃，阳光正好，注意补水，享受美好一天。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is clear at 19℃. The sun is out, remember to hydrate!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，12℃ 体感稍凉，记得适时添衣，别着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is clear, 12℃ feels a bit cool, dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴好，12℃ 舒适，早晚温差大，别忘了添衣保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, 12℃ is pleasant. Mind the temperature changes, dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，10℃ 体感略凉，多穿衣，注意保湿。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 10℃ feels a bit cool, dress warmly and moisturize.
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，13℃ 体感微凉，记得添件薄外套哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, 13℃ feels slightly cool. Grab a light jacket!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，8℃ 体感较凉，多穿衣服，小心感冒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear, 8℃ feels quite cool, dress warmly and watch out for colds.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾 12℃，能见度低，出行慢点，注意安全哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy at 12℃, low visibility, drive carefully and stay safe!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒 -20℃，请务必严实保暖，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold at -20℃, please bundle up very well and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷 -7℃，风力大体感更低，注意防风保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and cold at -7℃, strong winds make it feel colder, stay warm!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗 14℃，体感舒适，紫外线强，注意防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear at 14℃, feels pleasant. UV is strong, remember sun protection.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗 16℃，风力较大，湿度高，享受好天气。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is clear at 16℃, windy with high humidity, enjoy the fine weather!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾 8℃，风力大能见度低，出行注意安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy at 8℃, strong winds and low visibility, please be safe when out!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾 0℃，风大体感更冷，注意防霾保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is hazy at 0℃, strong wind makes it colder, mind the haze and stay warm.
